title: The Donkey Who Talked
reflectionQuestion: Balaam could not see the angel, but his faithful donkey could. I wonder who God might use to help you, in a way that would surprise you?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (filed under Moses & Exodus -- wilderness era). Batch D 'talking-animal / funny' piece -- likely a top replay candidate (a donkey that talks = peak 5-year-old). SOFTENED per Adam: the angel's sword is omitted; Balaam is 'frustrated' and gives 'a little smack' (NOT beating/cruelty), nothing dwelt on. The donkey is the lovable hero -- she SEES the angel Balaam can't, and stops THREE times to PROTECT him; the angel is framed as keeping Balaam safe, not threatening. God lets her speak: 'why are you cross with me? Haven't I always been your good donkey?' Room = God can use anyone (even a donkey!) / stop and pay attention. Donkey referred to as 'she' (faithful companion). Soft close ('attention'). VOICE_ARCHER (bright, lively, characterful -- carries the comedy).
